name: steps
desc: Daily step-goal progress. Polled once per minute tick (cheap cached health read), dirties the bars layer solely on percent change. Goal is a persisted Clay setting.

clay.label: Daily Step Goal
clay.description: Progress bar fills as you approach this many steps.

cost.wakeups: none beyond the shared minute tick (no separate subscription)
cost.redraws: bars layer, only when the percent value changes
cost.persist: goal integer, written solely when the setting changes
cost.notes: No health event subscription; the minute tick poll is the only read.
